content: I have just pushed a commit to a PR branch of mine (#39127), but it looks like CI does not trigger as it usually does. Is this a known problem?

Indeed, it's suspicious that there have been no new CI jobs for ~20 minutes: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/actions (and the errors from the last few jobs seem to be "unable to access 'https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/': The requested URL returned error: 403" which is strange as well).

Most likely an issue on GitHub's side, but I don't see anything announced yet at https://githubstatus.com
The Lean core CI has also had all kinds of strange issues today. It's definitely GitHub's fault.
Here's the incident: #rss > GitHub Status - Incident History @ 💬
